summary: IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance are persistently disabled on node1. The settings remained enforced after a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Created /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf with global, default, enp1s0, and loopback values set to 0.
Applied and verified the settings at runtime.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the node recovered healthy with no failed units and all hardened values still set to 0.

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
evidence.summary: Direct pre- and post-restart output shows the persistent file and all relevant runtime sysctls set to 0.
Captured original boot ID, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, observed a changed boot ID, and verified system_state=running, failed_units=0, and persisted hardening after recovery.
